usedFor: Razorpay handles payments, and Freshdesk gains a helpdesk contact through “Create a Contact” from each “A New Refund Is Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “A New Refund Is Created” in Razorpay, then “Create a Contact” in Freshdesk
bestTemplate.why: A refund puts the customer in the helpdesk before their question arrives, ready for support to find.

watchOut: One customer with several refunds runs “Create a Contact” each time, so check Freshdesk for duplicates.
